test_objective: Verify that PATCH HTTP requests can be done with "application/merge-patch+json" as Content-Type

test_cases.name: 044_01_01 endpoint /entities/{entityId}/attrs/{attrId}
test_cases.doc: Verify that PATCH HTTP requests can be done with "application/merge-patch+json" as Content-Type
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{entityId}/attrs/{attributeId}'
        method set to 'PATCH'
        Request Partial Update Entity Attributes and
    Query Parameter: entityId set to '${entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: AttributeId set to 'brandName' and
    Query Parameter: fragment_filename set to 'vehicle-brandname-fragment.json' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/merge-patch+json' and
    Query Parameter: context set to 'https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld'
}
